content.text: Neck: no skin dryness, masses, discoloration, lesions, scars, or edema. no webbing, fullness in the neck base, carotid prominence, jugular distension, overlying skin change or deformities. SCM and trapezius is symmetric. B/L Anterior and posterior cervical triangles present and unobstructed. No spinal deviation or tracheal deviation. No tenderness on palpation of cervical spine and para vertebral muscles. Swallow symmetry. Range of motion intact. Thyroid:is symmetric with normal consistency of the thyroid tissue and configuration. no tenderness on palpation, enlargement, nodules, or edema. Symmetric coordinated swallow. negative thyroid auscultation. Lymph Nodes: no overlying erythema, lymphangitic streaking, visual edema, visual enlargement. Nodes are soft, freely mobile, and discrete with no enlargement, warmth, and tenderness in the occipital, pre/post auricular, retro-pharyngeal, parotid, submandibular, submental, anterior/posterior cervical, supraclavicular, infraclavicular, epitrochlear, inguinal, femoral, popliteal lymph nodes.
